role: Generator that writes the enchantment registry (effectId, weight, level range, enchantability windows, type ordinal, canApplyTogether bitmask) as the C header csrc/engine/enchants.h, read from the oracle's own Enchantment objects.
used_by: csrc/engine/enchants.h (generated; included by csrc/engine/enchant.c and csrc/engine/trades.c)
run by hand: java -cp ... netherite.oracle.EnchantTable ../csrc/engine/enchants.h (no Makefile target, unlike biomes-h/blocks-h/items-h)
notes: The string EnchantTable in oracle/src/tileentity/TileEntity.java is the tile entity id of TileEntityEnchantmentTable, not a call into this class, so it has no vanilla hooks. No oracle/src file calls into it (grep of oracle/src for the class name); used_by paths under out/java were listed, not opened.
